name: Brunswick Parks & Recreation Summer Programs
description_short: A list of summer programs that the Town of Brunswick Parks & Recreation usually runs, including a general Summer Day Camp and many sports, arts, STEM and outdoor camps for kids. Details and registration are in the town's CivicRec online catalog.
swim_waterfront_notes: The town lists "Learn to Swim at Coffin Pond" as a summer program. No other waterfront details are given.

warnings: Filled zip 04011: Brunswick has one ZIP code (2020 Census)
This page is the town's index of summer programs, not the listing for one camp. It names about 25 programs (day camps, sport clinics, adult leagues, special events) with no details.
No season year, dates, prices or ages appear on the page. The page says these programs are 'usually held', so 2027 offerings may differ.
The phone number and address given are Town Hall's general contact, not necessarily the Parks & Recreation office.
Some listed items are adult programs or events (Pickleball, Women's Softball League, Adult Kickball, Movies in the Park), not youth camps.
Youth Field Hockey Clinic is marked TBA.
